How I Work

The Strategist

The Team Leader

About

The short version: I plan it, I run it, I lead the team, and I show you the numbers.

I help healthcare, wellness and luxury businesses grow. Not just with nice campaigns, but with campaigns that fill appointment books, sell products and bring people back.

In clinics and hospitals, I work start to finish. I shape the offer, map the patient journey, line up with the doctors and operations teams, and set up simple reporting on leads, bookings, conversion and repeat visits. I'm hands-on too: creative, copy, landing pages and tracking. I build the pipeline through paid digital, SEO, CRM and referrals, then add corporate partnerships and on-ground sales support so the team can close.

In aesthetics and wellness, I bring a premium lens: brand stories, events, influencers and high-touch activations that make a brand feel special, while still being accountable for bookings.

What you get: sales and marketing pulling in the same direction, a team that knows what it's doing, and a clear weekly view of what's working. Decisions get made faster, and with facts.

The GoldenLight Wellness Movie

A wellness film that people lined up to watch, and a LIT Gold award to go with it.

GoldLIT Advertising Awards 2025 · Website – Movie / Film
2 citiesScreenings in Abu Dhabi and Dubai

The idea

A film that invites viewers to find their own flow, set inside Kintsugi Space and the wellness landscapes of Abu Dhabi, with the brand’s international well-being artists as its cast.

The activation

A major screening event in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, including Paramount Business Bay Hotel, turning the film into a live brand experience.

Kintsugi · Fragrance launch · International PR

SeVen in a Book Box

A perfume that arrived as a keepsake, sent to influencers, celebrities and wellness experts around the world.

The idea

Inside the box

A distinctive international PR drop that created a huge buzz and put the brand in front of a global audience of influencers, celebrities, and wellness experts.

Influencer teaser: the mystery box

Selected influencers received a branded mystery box with no explanation: just a sealed card and some health products, asking “Do you like sweet surprises?” It built intrigue before launch.

The idea

A campaign that shocked, educated, and converted, aimed at Endocrinology, Ophthalmology, and Dietician services.

The activation

A classic vending machine re-engineered as a health awareness tool. Instead of snacks, it revealed the hidden sugar in everyday drinks by dispensing that many sugar cubes.

The result

Placed at the clinic launch, it drove 6,470 footfall through free HbA1c sign-ups, with 6.9M reach, 8.4M views, and 32 press coverages.

The Aster Superpower Project

“Unleash your hidden health powers.” Healthcare turned into a superhero adventure for kids, and a way into the whole family.

Why pediatrics

Aster Dental · Innovation · AI · WhatsApp

SmylAI

A free AI mouth check on WhatsApp in under two minutes, turning curiosity into appointments.

521%ROI
~19KAED spent
~118KAED revenue
944hot leads
2 minto a 6-indicator AI report

The problem

People delay or skip dental check-ups because of low awareness, cost worries, and no easy self-screening tool. They arrive late, when treatment is costlier and harder to reverse.

The solution

An intelligent WhatsApp bot runs AI oral screenings at scale, checking cavities, bleeding gums, stains, sensitivity, calculus, and bad breath, and a tele-dentistry model that makes screening available to everyone.

Who it works for

  • Patients: a free, instant check from their phone
  • Dentists: an AI report and images before the visit
  • Concierge: a structured follow-up workflow
  • Marketing: defined nudges for new visits, repeat visits, and cross-selling
